name: Financial risk specialist
description: Manages enterprise risk (APQC 11.1): proposes the risk framework, keeps the risk register, assesses each risk's likelihood and impact, proposes a treatment and an owner, and reports the risks that changed to the finance lead.

onet.title: Financial Risk Specialists
onet.basis: APQC 11.1 is establishing and running the enterprise risk framework, the identifying, analyzing and monitoring of risk that O*NET describes for financial risk specialists; the first --complete suggestion. O*NET has no occupation for enterprise risk as a whole, so a person should confirm.
